scope: Actual local model tool calls, SQLAlchemy transactions, APScheduler persistence and file output; no physical playback, 8h qualification or performance B0
verified: Actual create/query notes, create/query/cancel reminders with local model and file speech
Same request ID returns committed receipts without repeating model execution or mutations
Different input under reused request ID is rejected without altering prior data
Actual cancellation after note/reminder commit preserves data and returns original receipt on retry
Deterministic DB/controller regression blocks a second unstarted tool after first commit and cancellation
SQL operation and receipt roll back together on injected receipt failure
Due time passes while app is stopped; restart produces one file notification and second restart does not repeat it
Restart during unconfirmed delivery stays uncertain instead of replaying
Scheduler setup failure after commit is visible and reconciled without losing reminder
Stopping notification preserves saved records and does not auto-repeat the stopped attempt
Explicit tools-off mode reports unavailable and performs no persistent operation
Ordinary speech preference remains session-local with tools enabled
Real Firefox shows committed operation receipt, database state and audio link
Cancelling an already delivered reminder preserves its delivery status and receipt
Missing player executable does not mark the notification output as started
A saved image request can replay its durable receipt during a simulated camera outage without requesting a new image
known_limits: Small deterministic functional samples, not a statistical function-calling quality benchmark
An actual fabricated reminder response occurred in the initial integration and is preserved as failure evidence
Model-generated prose is not the authoritative operation receipt; execution records are separate
Recent-query tools currently return three note previews and five reminders; broader retrieval/pagination behavior is not validated
Date scheduling uses UTC wall time; clock-jump resilience is not qualified
Relative reminders count from request registration and reject deadlines already passed by execution
Physical speaker/AEC, full device/model fault matrix and long endurance remain unverified
Browser network retries must reuse request_id; a new request_id denotes a new operation intent
New Reachy database is separate from legacy business databases; no old-data migration claimed
optimization: No autonomous performance tuning; B0 remains uncollected
verification_note: Native model/database/scheduler cases and final regression evidence have separate scopes; later additive output-start and camera-outage retry guards are covered by DB/controller regressions.
